title: $10,000/Month GPU Server… FOR FREE? 🤯
one_sentence_summary: This video provides a complete walkthrough on setting up a free AI server featuring 32GB of VRAM using dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs on Kaggle to run large language models like Qwen and Ollama.
key_takeaways: Utilize Kaggle notebooks to access free cloud compute resources with 32GB VRAM powered by 2 x NVIDIA T4 GPUs.
Ensure your Kaggle account has a verified phone number and the accelerator settings configured to dual Tesla T4 GPUs before starting.
Install Ollama within the Kaggle environment to manage and run large language models seamlessly via Linux package management.
Download large GGUF format models directly from repositories like Hugging Face into your environment for execution.
Expose your locally running Ollama instance to the web using Cloudflare tunnels to generate accessible public APIs and interact remotely.

actionable_frameworks.description: A sequential methodology using Kaggle notebooks configured with dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs, Ollama installation, and Cloudflare tunneling to run and expose large language models for free.
